newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold down near close, silver ranged.
newsitem.headline: India gold down near close, silver ranged.

text.p: Gold prices opened on a quiet note but suffered a setback towards the close on the back of unloading by stockists on fears that the customs department may sell confiscated gold ahead of Diwali festival, dealer said.
Gold was down by 5 rupees per 10 gramme on Wednesday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) fell by 200 rupees to close at 60,200 rupees each.
Reports of a weak trend in the world market also dragged local prices downward but traders were expecting fresh physical buying to emerge at the reduced level ahead of the Hindu feast.
Silver moved in a narrow range and finished on a quiet note amid limited activity during the day. Silver was down by 75 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
The focus of trading was on gold while silver was neglected.
